test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Choose the address that is exactly the same as the one given below.

B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013 ?

options.text: B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Biharr - 800013
B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013
B6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013
B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800031

solution:
Given: B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013

Option 1) B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, __**Biharr**__ - 800013 → Incorrect

Option 2) B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013→ Correct

Option 3) __**B6**__, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - 800013→ Incorrect

Option 4) B-6, Lotus Enclave, Patliputra Colony, Patna, Bihar - __**800031**__→ Incorrect

Thus, the address in option 2 is exactly similar to the given address.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
